fields.text:
CODICIAN Club AUC is the premier student-led technical community at Amity University Chhattisgarh, committed to fostering innovation, coding excellence, research-driven learning, and technological leadership. We empower students to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital world by exploring emerging technologies, industry trends, and cutting-edge innovations that are shaping the future.  
     
Our club serves as a dynamic platform where passionate learners, innovators, and aspiring technology leaders come together to transform ideas into impactful solutions. Through a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and experimentation, we encourage students to move beyond theoretical knowledge and embrace practical, real-world applications of technology. .

fields.name: Amity University Raipur

fields.title: Cracking the Interviews in the AI Era 2026
fields.text:
Cracking Interviews in the AI Era an International Expert Talk Organized under the leadership
of Anuj Kumar (President) and Devanshu Dasgupta (Vice President), CODICIAN Club AUC. 
The session was delivered by Mr. Rohit Jain, Ex-Amazon Software Engineer, IIT Kharagpur
Alumnus (2019), Highest-Rated Udemy Instructor, and Software Development Engineer at
Square, Boston, USA.
The session was delivered by Mr. Rohit Jain, Ex-Amazon Software Engineer, IIT Kharagpur
Alumnus (2019), Highest-Rated Udemy Instructor, and Software Development Engineer at
Square, Boston, USA.
The session provided participants with valuable insights into navigating the evolving
landscape of technical interviews in an AI-driven world. Key discussions focused on Data
Structures & Algorithms, System Design, resume building, interview preparation strategies,
and the effective use of Artificial Intelligence as a productivity-enhancing tool while
maintaining strong engineering fundamentals.
The event served as an enriching platform for aspiring engineers to bridge the gap between
academic learning and industry expectations, empowering them with the knowledge,
confidence, and direction required to excel in modern technical interviews.

fields.title: Beyond the Prompt – Designing & Deploying Production-Ready AI Agents 2026
fields.text:
Beyond the Prompt – Designing & Deploying Production-Ready AI Agents Organized under
the leadership of Anuj Kumar (President) and Devanshu Dasgupta (Vice President),
CODICIAN Club AUC successfully hosted “Beyond the Prompt – Designing & Deploying
Production-Ready AI Agents” in collaboration with ASET and AIIT at Amity University
Chhattisgarh.
The session was delivered by Mr. Dishant Gandhi, AI/ML Consultant & Engineer, Rasa Open
Source Contributor, and IEEE Young Professional, bringing extensive expertise in Generative
AI, Conversational AI, and Large Language Models.
Focused on bridging the gap between AI concepts and real-world implementation, the
session explored Agentic AI, intelligent agent architectures, Retrieval-Augmented Generation
(RAG), AI tools and workflows, and the development of production-ready AI systems.
